# Phase 3: The 21-paper curriculum, merged with the concept deep-dives

*weeks 5–20* · [Track on the site](https://arubad.github.io/AI_Research_Journey/#p3)

Your paper sequence stays intact; what changes is that each paper now also carries the interview questions and "what to master" items from Alisa's map, and each experiment carries a HAND / HAND→AGENT / AGENT tag. The weekly loop per paper (Day 1 read, Day 2 derive and watch, Day 3 break it) is in the Execution section. Paper 1 (AlexNet) is already done in your notebook; start at Paper 2.

**What goes on the CV from this phase.** Two or three of the HAND→AGENT experiments, polished into small public repos with a README that states the hypothesis, the one-line change that broke the equation, and the plot. Candidates: the Transformer scaling/masking ablation (#4), the MoE routing-collapse study (#18), and the GRPO group-size study (#19). These are the ones you can defend line by line in a technical discussion.
